title: Tokens, bigrams and the most common words
instructions:
## Text becomes a list

Every NLP pipeline starts by turning text into tokens. Write the first steps.

1. `tokenize(text)`: lower-case the text and return the list of words, where a word is a maximal run of letters, digits or apostrophes (so `"Kofi's"` stays one token and punctuation is dropped).
2. `bigrams(tokens)`: the list of consecutive pairs as tuples.
3. `top_words(text, n)`: the `n` most frequent tokens as `(word, count)` tuples, most frequent first; ties broken alphabetically.

realityNote: Real tokenisers (spaCy, SentencePiece) handle contractions, hyphens, emoji and languages without spaces; subword tokenisers split rare words into pieces. The regular expression here is the baseline every one of them improves on.
